content.title: Mud With a Purpose
content.narrative:
YY found the bank changed before he found the food.

Fresh paw-smoothed mud slopes down to the brook where yesterday there was only a steep cut bank; small tracks go all the way to the water. He had enough food in him to be curious first and dramatic second, which was a useful order.

"Well," YY said. "That is not snack-shaped. Rude, but interesting."

YY tested the new mud ramp, slipped once, then used it to reach sweet grass at the waterline. No one had asked him to name it. That helped. YY liked a thing better when it did not arrive wearing a job.

By sundown his food had moved from 0.62 to 0.64, health from 0.84 to 0.85, and attention from 0.70 to 0.72. YY did not say the numbers out loud. He did say, very softly, "Noted."

He came home with the mud with a purpose behind him, a little more food than he woke with, and one clear place in the wood changed enough to remember.

content.summary: YY met mud with a purpose on 2026-05-13, answered it with a practical body-first choice, and came home with the wood slightly better mapped.
